env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/nv$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/nv$GOEXE
stdout '^direct-checked method-value-ok iface-ok$'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/a/a.lgo --
package a

type User struct {
	Name string
}

type Box struct {
	X int
}

func (b *Box) Set(u *User) string {
	return "set"
}

type Setter interface {
	Set(u *User) string
}

var _ Setter = &Box{}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"example.com/l/a"
)

func Run() string {
	out := ""
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				if strings.Contains(fmt.Sprint(r), "logos:") {
					out += "direct-checked"
				} else {
					out += "direct-UNCHECKED:" + fmt.Sprint(r)
				}
			}
		}()
		b := &a.Box{}
		_ = b.Set(nil)
		out += " direct-no-panic"
	}()
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += " method-value-PANIC:" + fmt.Sprint(r)
			}
		}()
		var n *a.Box
		f := n.Set
		if got := f(nil); got != "set" {
			out += " method-value-bad"
			return
		}
		out += " method-value-ok"
	}()
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += " iface-PANIC:" + fmt.Sprint(r)
			}
		}()
		var i a.Setter = (*a.Box)(nil)
		if got := i.Set(nil); got != "set" {
			out += " iface-bad"
			return
		}
		out += " iface-ok"
	}()
	return out
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(q.Run()) }
